paragraphs: R. Chiyya bar Natan, in R. Yochanan's time. In Pesachim 41a, near the end, the son of Rav Natan reports a teaching of Rav Chisda. Whether he was in R. Yochanan's time requires investigation, for Rav Chisda appears to have lived after R. Yochanan. Whence the statement that he lived in R. Yochanan's time? See there.
